lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Tomorrow we run the plate experiment in public. Everything open: the method, the data, the mistakes.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: And three independent groups run the same experiment at the same time, across town. If they get our result, it's real.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: And if they don't?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Then we were wrong in front of everybody, and we learn something. Win-win.

lines.speaker: BRACKET
lines.text: Gentlemen! Lyle Bracket, Ovid Venture Partners. The door was open. I love an open door.

lines.speaker: BRACKET
lines.text: Two hundred and fifty thousand dollars for an exclusive licence on R.A.I.N. We close the code, we polish the brand, everybody gets rich.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: That's generous. And no.

lines.speaker: BRACKET
lines.text: Closed systems sell, Mister Woodyard. Open ones get copied. The offer stands. For your friend, too.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: He seems nice.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: He seems like a man who's never been told no by a garage. Let's get the kits out.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Three replication kits: a plate, a generator, a pinch of sand, and instructions a teenager can follow.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: One to the physics teacher at Garcia High, one to the ham radio club in Ocean Flats, one to the kid who won the science fair.

lines.speaker: TEACHER
lines.text: Real equipment? For my class? Oh, they are going to lose their minds.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Four forty-two hertz, tomorrow at noon. Write down whatever you see.

lines.speaker: TEACHER
lines.text: Even if it's nothing?

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Especially if it's nothing. That's what he says.

lines.speaker: HAM
lines.text: A Chladni plate. We'll calibrate the generator against our frequency standard. To the hertz.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Man, you're gonna be good at this.

lines.speaker: KID
lines.text: If your result doesn't replicate, I'm putting that in my report.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Kid, that's exactly what he wants.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Black sedan, three cars back. It's been there since Garcia.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Ovid's people. If they rattle the van hard enough, the kits crack. Lose them.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: That knock broke a kit. One group fewer.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: They've dropped off. Good driving.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: The pier. Look at all these people. Some of them even came on purpose.

lines.speaker: OFFICIAL
lines.text: Deputy Commissioner Halvorsen, procurement. This event has no permit for experimental equipment. Shut it down.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: It's a speaker and a metal plate, Commissioner. The schematics are on the registry. You're welcome to check them.

lines.speaker: OFFICIAL
lines.text: I am not here to check things. I am here to stop things.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Lady, that's the whole problem with this city.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: The generator's dead. Somebody pulled the fuse. There! The guy in the overalls!

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Carl, get that fuse back. Don't hurt him.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Give it here, man! Now!

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Fuse is in. We're live.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: He got away. We'll run it off the van battery. It'll be quieter, but it'll work.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Four hundred and forty-two hertz. Watch the sand.

lines.speaker: CROWD
lines.text: Whoa! It's making a pattern!

lines.speaker: TEACHER
lines.text: Garcia High here! Same pattern! Crosses and curves, exactly like your picture!

lines.speaker: HAM
lines.text: Ocean Flats Amateur Radio Club. Mode confirmed at four forty-two, plus or minus one.

lines.speaker: KID
lines.text: It worked. I hate that it worked. It's in my report.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: R.A.I.N.'s question for all of us: does the result hold up?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Accepted. Independent groups, independent equipment, same result. That's what real looks like.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Reject it? Carl, they all got the pattern. On their own kit.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: We don't need to abstain. More than one independent replication. We can say it.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Abstained. One replication is a promising start, not a confirmation. We publish it as exactly that.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Accept, on one replication? I'd love to. That's exactly why we shouldn't.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Reject? One group confirmed it. That's not nothing. It's not enough, either.

lines.speaker: OFFICIAL
lines.text: ...The city will be reviewing its permit process.

lines.speaker: BRACKET
lines.text: Carl. A word. Your friend won't sell. But friends can be persuaded.

lines.speaker: BRACKET
lines.text: Fifty thousand dollars. Cash. All you have to do is talk him round.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: ...Fifty thousand?

lines.speaker: BRACKET
lines.text: Pleasure doing business. Do your best with him. Or don't. I'll know.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: He already told you no. That's the only answer you're getting from either of us.

lines.speaker: BRACKET
lines.text: Shame. Open systems get copied, you know.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Yeah. That's the point, genius.

lines.speaker: NEWS
lines.text: An independent San Fierro lab demonstrated a sound experiment live at the pier, while schools and a radio club across the city reproduced it at the same time.

lines.speaker: NEWS
lines.text: The lab's code and data are freely available on an open registry. A venture firm's offer to license the work was declined.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Forty thousand downloads. Three replications. Two of them by people under eighteen.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: So what now? More experiments?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Always. The lab's open whenever you want it, Carl. R.A.I.N. has questions nobody's asked yet.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Long as none of them gets the cops on me.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: I can't promise that. But I can promise we'll check the evidence first.
